current.summary: I lead CMS architecture and delivery across client engagements, combining technical planning with hands-on implementation and release verification.
bullets: Design and build Drupal and WordPress platforms, custom modules, themes and integrations; plan migrations and maintainable content models.
Develop decoupled React and Next.js interfaces backed by GraphQL and REST APIs, supporting content delivery and editorial workflows.
